ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: incubus
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Incubi are devils of the bargain. Everything has a price, and they are very, very good at collecting.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Every deal has a price. Put enemies in debt and collect, sign contracts with your friends, and steal what you covet.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Sign here,' he said. 'And here. And initial here. This one is your soul. Lovely.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Lay Debts with hellfire brands, chains and commands. At five Debts the Incubus collects: hellfire, a share of the victim's vitality, and the weapon out of its hands. Devil's Due calls in every Debt on the map at once. Infernal Contracts make an ally monstrously strong if they deliver two kills. Only men can take this path. Wants Potency and Attunement.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: pactbinder
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Pactbinders are the accountants of hell, and nothing in hell is more frightening than an accountant.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Every soul has a price, and every price has interest. Usury, collateral, blood contracts and foreclosure.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: He does not need to fight. Everyone already owes him.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: The Debt engine. Usury makes Debts accrue on their own, Soul Collateral pays you when a debtor dies, Breach of Contract cashes Debts in for enormous single-target damage, and Foreclosure collects from everyone around you at once. Blood Contracts make an ally a demigod for a minute. Wants Potency and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: dreamlord
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: The incubus of legend comes in dreams. The Dreamlord just does it to whole armies.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: He visits in the night. Possess enemies through their dreams, plant nightmares that spread, and rule the dreaming world.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: They found the guards asleep at their posts, smiling, and the gate wide open.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Possession and spreading nightmares. Possess takes an enemy for thirty seconds; Nightmare Seed eats its host and jumps to everyone nearby when the host dies; Sleep Paralysis pins a target in place. The Lord of Dreams possesses or paralyses every enemy on the map. Wants Attunement and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: hellprince
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Some incubi bargain. Hellprinces remember who they were before they learned to smile, and they do not bargain.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Stop pretending. Take your true form, drag enemies in with a lash of hellfire, and open the gates of hell.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The horns were always there. He just stopped hiding them.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A burning brawler. Hellfire Lash drags enemies to you, Infernal Form doubles your strength and armours you in hellfire, Hellhounds and Hellgates scorch everything near them, and the Crown of Ash turns you into a walking inferno that lays Debts on everything it burns. Wants Potency and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: compound interest
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Infernal spells sometimes add an extra Debt.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: interest
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Whenever you collect, you open a new account: a free Hellfire Brand at the nearest enemy.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: ledger
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every closed account pays out in mana.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: silver-tongued
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You always get the better end of the deal.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: loan shark
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Payment is due now. Devil's Due and Collect come back far sooner, and everything infernal hits harder.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: prince of lies
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everyone owes you, and nobody can pin you down: half your infernal hits add a Debt, and attacks often find only an illusion.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: archdevil
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Hell follows you. Anything you kill may burst into hellfire.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: creditor
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every debtor who dies frees up your schedule.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: witnessed
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Contracts you witness last longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: hostile takeover
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every infernal hit adds a Debt (at most twice a second).

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: bankrupt
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Cash out constantly. Breach of Contract and Garnishment come back far sooner, and everything infernal hits harder.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: phantasm
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Blows aimed at you sometimes strike a dream.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: puppetmaster
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Possessions last longer and come back sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: incubate
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Dream spells sometimes plant a nightmare.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: dream tyrant
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Possess takes two minds at once and returns sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: nightmare lord
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every nightmare you plant is deeper and crueller.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: pack leader
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: One more hellhound per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: wrath
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Wounding a prince of hell only makes him angrier.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: firestorm
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: One more falling stone per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: infernal
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Whoever strikes you in melee is burned by hellfire.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: gates of hell
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Open an extra gate per rank, and keep them open longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: warlord of hell
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You barely remember your mortal shape. Infernal Form lasts twice as long and returns much sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: pyrelord
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything you burn burns hotter, and the dead burst into hellfire.

AbilityDef.label: hellfire brand
AbilityDef.description: Fling a brand of violet hellfire. It burns, and it marks the target as owing you: one Debt.

AbilityDef.label: covet
AbilityDef.description: Covet an enemy's weapon, and it is yours: it tears out of their hands and lands at your feet. The enemy owes you for the trouble.

li.flavor: Thou shalt not. He does anyway.

AbilityDef.label: command: kneel
AbilityDef.description: Speak with the voice of a prince of hell. The target kneels for five seconds, takes more damage while it does, and owes you two Debts.

AbilityDef.label: hellchains
AbilityDef.description: Burning chains erupt from the ground in an area, binding every enemy there for six seconds and burning them. One Debt each.

AbilityDef.label: collect
AbilityDef.description: Call in a debt early: hellfire damage, +50% for every Debt the target owes (all of them spent).

AbilityDef.label: infernal contract
AbilityDef.description: Offer an ally a contract: for forty seconds they are monstrously strong. If they make two kills before it runs out they are rewarded; if not, the devil collects.

li.flavor: Read the fine print. Actually, don't.

AbilityDef.label: pact of flame
AbilityDef.description: Make a pact with hellfire for thirty seconds: immune to burning, and your spells burn hotter.

AbilityDef.label: soul bargain
AbilityDef.description: Sell a little of your own soul: lose some health, regain two fifths of your mana at once.

AbilityDef.label: brimstone
AbilityDef.description: Brimstone erupts from the earth in an area: eight burning strikes, each one laying a Debt half the time.

AbilityDef.label: devil's due
AbilityDef.description: Call in every debt at once. Every enemy on the map takes hellfire damage, +60% for every Debt it owes (spent).

AbilityDef.label: deal with the devil
AbilityDef.description: Offer a colonist a deal. They will gain something wonderful: an inspiration, years of skill, a healed body or fantastic luck. Usually.

AbilityDef.label: usury
AbilityDef.description: Charge interest on an enemy's soul: for twenty seconds it gains a Debt every two seconds.

AbilityDef.label: soul collateral
AbilityDef.description: Take an enemy's soul as collateral and lay two Debts. If it dies within thirty seconds, you regain mana and a ward, your other spells cool down by half, and its friends inherit the debt.

AbilityDef.label: breach of contract
AbilityDef.description: Punish a defaulter: hellfire damage, +40% for every Debt (spent), plus a share of its vitality.

AbilityDef.label: garnishment
AbilityDef.description: Garnish the wages of everyone around you: hellfire damage, doubled against anyone in debt, healing you for two fifths.

AbilityDef.label: blood contract
AbilityDef.description: Offer an ally a contract written in a great deal of blood: overwhelming power for a minute, paid for with three kills.

AbilityDef.label: foreclosure
AbilityDef.description: Foreclose on every soul within fifteen cells: each one is driven five Debts deeper and collected at once.

AbilityDef.label: nightmare seed
AbilityDef.description: Plant a nightmare in an enemy. It feeds on its host for twenty seconds, and if the host dies it seeds itself in everyone nearby.

AbilityDef.label: sleep paralysis
AbilityDef.description: Something sits on an enemy's chest: it cannot move for eight seconds and suffers. Machines do not dream.

AbilityDef.label: waking nightmare
AbilityDef.description: Pull the nightmares of everyone in an area into the waking world: they flee in terror for seven seconds.

AbilityDef.label: dreamshroud
AbilityDef.description: Step halfway into the dreaming world for fifteen seconds: enemies cannot see you.

AbilityDef.label: possess
AbilityDef.description: Slip into an enemy's dreams and take the wheel: for thirty seconds it fights for you. Not the mightiest, and not machines too big to dream.

AbilityDef.label: lord of dreams
AbilityDef.description: Rule the dreaming world. Every enemy on the map is either possessed for twenty seconds or paralysed in its sleep, and all of them owe you.

AbilityDef.label: hellfire lash
AbilityDef.description: Crack a whip of hellfire at an enemy and drag it through the air to your feet, burning.

AbilityDef.label: infernal form
AbilityDef.description: Take your true shape for forty seconds: horns and hellfire, twice the strength, heavy armour and immunity to fire.

AbilityDef.label: hellhounds
AbilityDef.description: Whistle up two hellhounds for a minute. They are savage, immune to fire and scorch everything they stand near.

AbilityDef.label: rain of brimstone
AbilityDef.description: Five burning stones fall from the sky on and around the target.

AbilityDef.label: hellgate
AbilityDef.description: Tear open a crack into hell for thirty seconds. It breathes hellfire on every enemy near it and lays Debts on them.

AbilityDef.label: crown of ash
AbilityDef.description: Crown yourself in hellfire for thirty seconds: you take your infernal form, and everything within six cells of you burns and falls into debt every second and a half.

HediffDef.label: debt
HediffDef.description: This creature owes the Incubus. Debts make it hesitate and fumble; at five he comes to collect: hellfire, a share of its very vitality, and the weapon from its hands.

HediffDef.label: infernal contract
HediffDef.description: Signed in blood: tremendous strength for forty seconds, but the contract must be paid with two kills, or the devil collects.

HediffDef.label: blood contract
HediffDef.description: A greater contract, written in a great deal of blood: overwhelming power for a minute, paid for with three kills.

HediffDef.label: contract fulfilled
HediffDef.description: The contract was honoured. The devil pays his debts too.

HediffDef.label: collected
HediffDef.description: The contract was broken, and the devil has collected his due: weak, aching and shaken.

HediffDef.label: hellchained
HediffDef.description: Bound by burning chains from below.

HediffDef.label: kneeling
HediffDef.description: Commanded to kneel, and unable to refuse.

HediffDef.label: pact of flame
HediffDef.description: Bound to hellfire: immune to burning, and every spell burns hotter.

HediffDef.label: usury
HediffDef.description: Interest accrues: another Debt every two seconds.

HediffDef.label: soul collateral
HediffDef.description: Its soul is pledged as collateral. If it dies, the Incubus collects the pledge.

HediffDef.label: nightmare seed
HediffDef.description: A nightmare has taken root. It feeds on its host and, if the host dies, it seeds itself in everyone nearby.

HediffDef.label: sleep paralysis
HediffDef.description: Awake but unable to move, with something sitting on its chest.

HediffDef.label: waking nightmare
HediffDef.description: Fleeing from something no one else can see.

HediffDef.label: infernal form
HediffDef.description: Wearing his true, infernal shape: horns, hellfire and terrible strength.

HediffDef.label: hellspawn
HediffDef.description: Born of hellfire: immune to burning, savage in a fight, and scorching to stand near.

ThingDef.label: hellgate
ThingDef.description: A crack into somewhere very hot. It breathes hellfire on every enemy nearby and lays debts on them. It closes after half a minute.
